description: NumberField renders a labeled native input type="number" and extends its standard number-input properties with step controls, field layout, validation, and adornments.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The label associated with the native number input.

elements.name: value / defaultValue
elements.description: Controls the numeric value or sets its initial value. value accepts a number or null.

elements.name: onValue
elements.description: Receives the parsed number whenever the field changes, or null when the input is empty.

elements.name: hasStep
elements.description: Shows the increment and decrement controls when true. Defaults to true. Controls are hidden when the field is disabled, read-only, or has step="any".

elements.name: step
elements.description: Sets the native stepping interval and controls the amount changed by the increment and decrement controls.

elements.name: min / max
elements.description: Sets native numeric bounds. The step controls stop when the next step would exceed these bounds.

elements.name: variant
elements.description: Sets the visual style to outlined (default) or underlined.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets the field size to sm, md (default), or lg.

elements.name: floatingLabel
elements.description: Places the label inside the field until it is focused or contains a value.

elements.name: labelPosition
elements.description: Places a non-floating label at the top (default) or left of the input.

elements.name: error
elements.description: Displays an error message, sets aria-invalid, and associates the message with the input through aria-describedby.

elements.name: iconLeft / iconRight
elements.description: Adds an SVG component or icon configuration as a left or right adornment.

elements.name: containerProps
elements.description: Passes native div properties to the field container.

elements.name: Native number-input properties
elements.description: Properties such as required, disabled, readOnly, placeholder, and step are forwarded to the native input.

accessibility.general: The component uses a native number input and associates it with the supplied label using for/id. Native keyboard, form, and validation behavior is preserved.
elements: Always provide a meaningful label; it is required by the component and remains available to assistive technologies.
Error messages are announced politely with aria-live="polite" and linked to the input with aria-describedby.
Use aria-invalid when the input is invalid without a visible error message, or use error when feedback should be displayed.
The increment and decrement controls are an additional pointer interaction; the native number input remains available for keyboard and assistive-technology interaction.
